covers.quote: For example, some departments use reference numbers instead of titles for some of their forms. Without a title, algorithms can’t find the forms easily. It also makes search harder for users if they don’t know the exact reference number for the form they’re looking for.

examples.note: The reference number appears after the descriptive form title.

parts.quote: Transfer your car to a new owner (Form 1066)

rules.quote: If you include a reference number, place it after the form’s title so the algorithm can find the form.
rules.violation_condition: a form title that places a reference number before or instead of the descriptive title
when: A form includes an official or departmental reference number in its title or heading.
rules.why: G-4: Specific actionable text instruction on form titles.
